k.q: Trace combined Boolean logic in an illustrative network-security alert.
k.code:
// A: unknown device; B: repeated failures; C: reported malware
A = true
B = false
C = true
if (A AND B) OR C then
    print("Investigate")
endif
p: Predict the output for A=true, B=false and C=true.
Change C to false and predict.
Describe one security event represented by A, B or C, and explain why this is only a simplified alert rule.
k.a: With A AND B=false but C=true, the full expression is true, so Investigate prints. Setting C=false produces no output. A represents an unknown device, B repeated failures and C a reported malware incident. Real security alerts need evidence and more sophisticated rules; this code does not identify malware.
